introduction_text: Saw a tree that needs care? Add a photo and tell us what is wrong.
name: report-a-tree
success_message: Our team has been told. You can follow progress under My status. See everything under My status (/my-status).
title: Report a tree

web_form_fields.label: Photo
web_form_fields.description: Take a photo of the tree

web_form_fields.label: What is wrong?
web_form_fields.options:
Dead tree
Damage
Watering
Pest / Disease
Leaning
Debris
Guard / Support
Other

web_form_fields.label: Spot or stretch?
web_form_fields.description: Spot = one tree has the problem. Stretch = several trees along a road have it.

web_form_fields.label: How many trees?
web_form_fields.description: Roughly how many trees have the problem.

web_form_fields.label: Where is the tree?
web_form_fields.description: We use your phone location. Move the pin if needed.
